# apple_retention_message (Resource)

Defines a retention message, which people see when they start to cancel an auto-renewable subscription. The message holds its content in `apple_retention_message_version` resources, and `apple_subscription_retention_message` assigns it to a subscription. An app can have 10 retention messages. A message can't change, so every change creates a new one. Destroying the resource deletes the message with its versions. Import it with `<app_id>/<id>`; `data.apple_retention_messages` lists an app's messages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_retention_message" "stay" {
  app_id         = data.apple_app.example.id
  reference_name = "Stay with us"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `reference_name` (String) Reference name of the message, which people don't see.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the retention message.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_retention_message.stay
  identity = {
    app_id = "6446452616"
    id     = "9137205548"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the retention message.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <app_id>/<id>
terraform import apple_retention_message.stay 6446452616/9137205548
```
